pathAssistantSteps.info: Expiry is approaching but outreach has not begun. Start within 180 days of lease end.
Renewal notice delivered to the tenant. Log the touch so the contact clock starts.
Waiting on the tenant. Log every follow-up in the Timeline — after 14 quiet days the renewal flags as non-responsive.
Terms under discussion. Record the proposed rate; log each round in the Timeline.
No pre-set option — the proposed rate needs owner sign-off. Use Submit for Approval; the decision moves this back to Negotiating.
Both sides aligned — the amendment is being drafted and signed.
Amendment executed and entered into Yardi. Status flips to Closed Won automatically.
Tenant declined to renew. Status flips to Closed Lost; the unit returns to market.
Tenant is vacating at lease end. Status flips to Closed Lost; coordinate move-out and turnover.
